_schema.description: Regression cases: known input -> expected-output examples for the roadmap decision logic. Each category is an array of self-contained cases consumed by task 45.3 (roadmap/tests/test_regression.py). Expected values were verified by reasoning about the actual implementations (SELECTION_WEIGHTS/SELECTION_MINIMUMS, the gate operator + fail-closed rule, the distress label/confidence rule, and the Hindi/English token-ratio definition).

fields.candidate_scores: object mapping model_id -> {criterion: score 0..100}; insertion order defines the first-wins tie-break order
fields.expected_selected: the selected model_id, or 'RETAIN_PHASE_1' when no candidate clears every per-criterion minimum
fields.expected_passing: list of model_ids that meet every per-criterion minimum, in input order

selection.notes: A criterion absent from a candidate's scores is treated as 0.0 (fail-closed). aggregate = sum(score*weight)/100; selection is the highest-aggregate candidate among those that pass every minimum.

gate_evaluation.component: roadmap.GateEvaluator with a clean LicensingRegister (no unresolved warning, nothing prohibiting)

fields.criteria: list of {metric_name, threshold, operator} used as the gate exit_criteria
fields.measured: object mapping metric_name -> measured value; a metric absent here is fail-closed
fields.expected_overall_passed: bool: true iff every criterion passes (register is clean)

fields.label: discrete emotion tag or null (failed/unavailable extraction)

emotion.notes: NEUTRAL when extraction failed or label is null. EMPATHETIC when the label is a distress label (sad/angry/fear) with confidence >= 0.50 (inclusive). STANDARD otherwise. V/A/D do not affect the mode decision and default to 0.0 in the consuming test.

fields.expected_within_tolerance: bool: true iff |output H/E ratio - input H/E ratio| <= 15 percentage points

hinglish_score.notes: H/E ratio = 100 * hindi / (hindi + english) over classifiable word tokens. A token is Hindi if it contains Devanagari or (casefolded) is in the engine's default Romanized->Devanagari mapping; a Latin word not in the mapping is English; other tokens are ignored. Text with no classifiable Hindi/English tokens has ratio 0.0.

description: Verified regression cases for the speech-native voice roadmap decision logic (selection, gate evaluation, emotion conditioning, Hinglish code-switch scoring).

selection.description: Single candidate scoring exactly at every per-criterion minimum -> it passes and is selected.
Single candidate below the license_permissiveness minimum (69 < 70) -> no candidate passes, retain Phase 1.
Two passing candidates -> the one with the higher weighted aggregate (alpha=90 vs beta=80) is selected.
Two passing candidates tied on aggregate (both 75) -> first-wins tie-break selects the first in input order.
A high-aggregate candidate that misses one minimum (community_activity=0 < 30) is NOT selected; a lower-aggregate passing candidate wins.
Candidate missing criteria -> missing scores are fail-closed (0.0), so it fails and Phase 1 is retained.

gate_evaluation.description: All criteria satisfied -> overall pass, not blocked.
One criterion fails (latency 350 > 300) -> overall fail, blocked.
A metric absent from measured values is fail-closed -> overall fail, blocked.
Boundary: measured equals threshold under '<=' -> passes.
Strict '>' with measured equal to threshold -> fails (50 > 50 is false).

emotion.description: Distress label (sad) at exactly the 0.50 confidence boundary -> EMPATHETIC (inclusive).
emotion.label: sad

emotion.description: Distress label (sad) just below the threshold (0.49) -> STANDARD.
emotion.label: sad

emotion.description: Distress label (angry) well above threshold -> EMPATHETIC.
emotion.label: angry

emotion.description: Non-distress label (happy) at high confidence -> STANDARD (not a distress label).
emotion.label: happy

emotion.description: Null label (extraction unavailable for label) -> NEUTRAL regardless of confidence.
Failed extraction (extraction_ok false) with a distress label -> NEUTRAL; the turn still continues.
emotion.label: fear

hinglish_score.description: Pure English input and output (ratios 0.0 and 0.0) -> within tolerance.
Pure Hindi (recognized Romanized) input and output (ratios 100.0 and 100.0) -> within tolerance.
Balanced 50/50 code-switch in both input and output (ratios 50.0 and 50.0) -> within tolerance.
Input all Hindi (100.0) vs output all English (0.0) -> 100 pp gap, outside tolerance.
Input ratio 50.0 vs output ratio 60.0 -> 10 pp gap, within tolerance.
Input ratio 50.0 vs output ratio 75.0 -> 25 pp gap, outside tolerance.
